title: The Menu Was Just A Formality
slides:
The menu was
just a formality.
caption:
Every couple has one order they pretend to rethink.

The menu opens.
She performs research.
He already knows the ending.

Pizza.
Hazelnut cold coffee.
Again.

Maybe love is not always surprise.
Sometimes love is the usual, chosen again.
